reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Sure. Three cues that fix most deadlift form problems: brace your core before you pull, like you're about to take a punch to the stomach. Keep the bar touching your shins the whole way up, which means shoulders over the bar at the start. Push the floor away with your legs instead of yanking with your back. If your lower back rounds at the bottom, drop the weight and film a set from the side, because that's the one to clean up before adding load."}
